issues.description: Users report being unable to sign in because the app will not accept their password or let them access their account.
Users object to features such as song selection and playback being restricted to Premium, and to content or features becoming premium-only after updates.
Users report missing songs, inconsistent lyrics availability, and unwanted recommendations.
Users report downloads getting stuck and offline listening not working.
Users express general dissatisfaction with the app or its support and say they are uninstalling, without specifying a concrete product problem.
Users report playback and app reliability problems, including songs failing to start or stopping, crashes, loading issues, connectivity trouble, and controls that do not work properly.
Users object to changes in playback controls, queueing, navigation, and frequent ads that interrupt listening.
